integrity: The all-dimensions theorem is proved analytically in RESULT.md. Finite exact rational and numerical checks supplement, not substitute for, the proof. No external certification or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns reversible nonnegative next-generation matrices with arbitrary allowed diagonals, exactly two prescribed row-sum values and strictly positive population fractions. It does not bound epidemic final size, stochastic fluctuations, matrices with prescribed zero diagonals or arbitrary more-than-two-rate row patterns. General SDP minimization for these matrices is prior work; explicit two-rate optimization and all-optimizer lumpability are the specific claim. Independent historical-priority assessment is not performed.
title: Exact sharp epidemic threshold and optimizer rigidity for two contact-rate classes
